claims.claim: DistilBERT uses triple pretraining loss: masked LM, distillation and cosine embeddings
claims.verification_note: Three separate objectives; no universal reduction constant.

claims.claim: DistilBERT paper reports 40 percent fewer parameters, 60 percent faster and 97 percent of evaluated language understanding capabilities
claims.verification_note: Results scoped to reported benchmarks, not universal hardware speed.

claims.claim: TinyBERT distills embeddings, intermediate hidden states, attention, prediction layer with general/task-specific stages
TinyBERT 4-layer reported teacher relative GLUE aggregate and inference gains for specific comparison
claims.verification_note: Do not interpret relative aggregate as per-task accuracy.

claims.claim: Temperature-scaled distillation compares softened teacher/student output distributions
claims.verification_note: T squared scaling is common formulation, not mandatory in each repo.

claims.claim: TinyBERT released research code provides two-stage scripts
claims.verification_note: Official code for mapping details; no results reproduced.
